answer: Require every agent identity to forge its reputation slowly: a newcomer stakes tokens that vest on a glacier-like schedule, unlocking only after sustained honest work, while each verified task adds a small delta to its standing. A sybil swarm faces the same price per identity, so forging a thousand fake agents costs a thousand stakes, and any caught fraud slashes the whole stake. Honest agents recoup theirs through fees; attackers pay full price for identities that earn nothing.
